Audience: first-time New Jersey Class D applicants, including teen drivers learning to watch for road users who are hard to see.
Why it matters to a first-timer: crosswalk duties are frequent knowledge-test items [A01], and the Safe Passing Law distances and speed are exact figures worth memorizing [A03].
Level: mixed recall and scenario judgment; moderate load, with several look-alike speeds and distances.
Prerequisites: the right-of-way, passing and railroad crossing rules from the safe driving rules sections.
